agent_feedback.analysis: The CKMLCR table stores period totals for material ledger values. It provides a comprehensive view of material valuation changes over time, enabling the tracking of inventory movements and associated costs. This table is commonly used for financial reporting, inventory analysis, and cost accounting purposes.
